subject: spanish

rounds.lie: “Las especies están en peligro de extinción” means “the spices are in danger”.
rounds.why: “Las especies” means “species” (animals/plants); “spices” is the near-miss word “las especias”.
rounds.truth: “Las especies están en peligro de extinción” means “the species are in danger of extinction”.

rounds.lie: “Grabar un vídeo” means “to delete a video”.
rounds.why: “Grabar” means “to record”, so it means “to record a video”; “to delete” is “borrar”.
rounds.truth: “Grabar un vídeo” means “to record a video”.

rounds.why: “La red” means “the net / network” (often the internet). “The screen” is “la pantalla”.

rounds.lie: “Vivo en las afueras” means “I live in the city centre”.
rounds.why: “Las afueras” means the outskirts/suburbs. “City centre” is “el centro (de la ciudad)”.
rounds.truth: “Vivo en las afueras” means “I live on the outskirts”.
truths: “Mi barrio es tranquilo” means “My neighbourhood is quiet”.
“Hay mucha contaminación” means “There is a lot of pollution”.

rounds.why: “La sequía” means “drought” (a lack of rain); a flood is “una inundación”.
“Un cantante” is a singer; “a song” is “una canción”.
truths: “Es famoso por su música” means “He is famous for his music”.
“Sigo a muchos influencers” means “I follow lots of influencers”.

rounds.why: False friend — “actualmente” means “currently / nowadays”. “Actually” is “en realidad / de hecho”.
truths: “Conectarse a internet” means “to connect to the internet”.
